markdown:
These Product-Specific Terms apply only to the extent identified on an Order Form for a
Subscription Service. All capitalized terms not defined in these Product-Specific Terms
have the meaning given to them in the agreement that grants Customer rights to access
and use the Subscription Service and any related order forms, use authorizations,
addenda, incorporated documents, and amendments (collectively, the “Agreement”),
without regard to the name of the underlying agreement, nor how it refers to its parties
or identifies Sitetracker’s Subscription Service.

In the event of any conflict between these Product-Specific Terms and the Agreement,
these Product-Specific Terms control.

## 1. General Terms

1.1. <u>Centralized Sitetracker Environment</u>. Customer Data may be transferred outside of
Customer’s Sitetracker instance to a centralized Sitetracker environment, which may be
hosted in a different Data Center Region from Customer’s originating Sitetracker
instance (“Centralized Sitetracker Environment”). The relevant terms set forth in the
Agreement pertaining to Sitetracker’s security and data protection program will apply to
the Centralized Sitetracker Environment, except for any terms relating to certifications,
attestations, and penetration testing conducted by Customer.

1.2. <u>Public Cloud Infrastructure</u>. The infrastructure used to host or process Customer
Data may be provided, in whole or in part, by a third-party public cloud provider.
Customer Data will be transferred between Sitetracker’s infrastructure, which may
include a Centralized Sitetracker Environment, and the third-party public cloud provider
and may be processed in a different Data Center Region from Customer’s originating
instance. The third-party public cloud provider will utilize industry-standard privacy and
security protections, which may differ from those of the Subscription Service. The
relevant terms set forth in the Agreement pertaining to Sitetracker’s security and data
protection program will apply to third-party public cloud hosting or processing, except for
terms regarding certifications, attestations, and Customer-conducted penetration
testing. Upon Customer’s request, Sitetracker will provide pertinent data security
documentation made available by the third-party public cloud provider.

1.3. <u>Updateability</u>. Sitetracker may update these Product-Specific Terms from time to
time, by posting to Sitetracker’s Legal Schedules page located at
https://www.sitetracker.com/legal (or any successor page), which will constitute notice to

---

Customer. Changes will apply immediately to any Subscription Services purchased after
the update. For any previously purchased Subscription Services, any updates (a) will
not materially degrade the overall performance or security posture of the Subscription
Service, except to the extent the updates are required to comply with applicable legal or
regulatory obligations, (b) will not expand Sitetracker’s ability to use Filtered AI Content
or restrict Customer’s ability to opt out of the creation of Filtered AI Content, and (c) will
not apply until the renewal of Customer’s then-current Subscription Term, except for any
updates (1) applicable to new features Customer chooses to use or (2) required to
address security, legal, regulatory, or system functionality issues. By continuing to use
the Subscription Service after any update, Customer agrees to be bound by the updated
terms.

1.4. <u>Commercial Availability</u>. If a Subscription Service identified in these
Product-Specific Terms is provided to Customer prior to general commercial availability,
Customer’s access and use of such Subscription Service will terminate on the earlier of:
(a) the termination date specified by Sitetracker in a written communication provided to
Customer (including via email); (b) the date the Subscription Service becomes
commercially available; or (c) the termination of the Agreement. Notwithstanding the
foregoing, Sitetracker may extend such access in its sole discretion.

## 2. Advanced AI and Data Products

2.1. <u>Applicable Products</u>. Advanced AI and Data Products are generative artificial
intelligence offerings made available by Sitetracker, including the Scout application,
features, and functionality.

2.2. <u>AI Limitations</u>. Artificial intelligence and machine learning are rapidly evolving fields
of study. Advanced AI and Data Products may use machine learning models that
generate predictions based on patterns in data. Output generated by a machine
learning model is probabilistic and should be evaluated by Customer for accuracy as
appropriate for Customer’s use case, including by employing human review of such
output. Advanced AI and Data Products may generate incorrect information, produce
harmful instructions or reflect biases due to the data or nature of how the model was
trained. None of the Advanced AI and Data Products provide legal or professional
advice. The outputs provided by the Advanced AI and Data Products are for
informational purposes only and are not a substitute for advice from a qualified
professional.

2.3. <u>EU Hosting</u>. Customer Data Processed by Sitetracker and its Sub-processors as
part of the provision of an Advanced AI and Data Product to the Customer which
originate from Customer instances located within the European Union will remain hosted within the European Union except to the extent: (1) authorized by Customer in
advance; (2) necessary to prevent or remediate a material issue involving security, data
loss prevention, disaster recovery, or critical maintenance or service availability; (3)
required by Law or to prevent fraud or abuse; or (4) documented in Customer support
(by or on behalf of Customer). The foregoing commitment does not supersede or modify
those contractual terms applicable to certain Sitetracker products or services that
require transfers of Customer Data to outside of the EU to use such products or
services, nor will it apply to any third-party integrations or services utilized or configured
by Customer that may transfer Customer Data to outside of the EU. Customer also
acknowledges and agrees that the foregoing commitment does not apply to information
provided to Sitetracker in respect of which Sitetracker is a data controller (e.g.
marketing, billing and account management data).

2.4. <u>Ownership</u>. Customer retains all ownership of Customer Data that is processed by
the Advanced AI and Data Products. To the extent permitted by law and excluding any
Sitetracker Property, Customer owns the output from the Advanced AI and Data
Products.

2.5. <u>Filtered AI Content</u>. Notwithstanding any terms to the contrary in the Agreement,
Sitetracker may use Filtered AI content only for the purpose of developing and
improving Sitetracker or its Affiliates’ technologies. ”Filtered AI Content” is Customer
Data used in connection with any Advanced AI and Data Products that Sitetracker uses
commercially reasonable efforts to remove Personal Data from. Sitetracker will own the
Filtered AI Content. Customer may opt-out of allowing Sitetracker to use Customer Data
to create Filtered AI Content by using the process set forth in the applicable product
documentation. Please note that the opt-out will not apply to data collected before the
opt-out is processed by Sitetracker. The terms set forth in the Agreement pertaining to
Sitetracker’s security and data protection program will apply to Sitetracker’s use of
Filtered AI Content. In the event of any conflict with the Agreement, the following terms
will govern:

2.5.1. <u>Security</u>. Sitetracker will maintain a written information program of policies,
procedures and controls aligned to the ISO27001 standards and will operate on SOC 2
Type 2 principles or substantially equivalent standard, which govern the processing,
storage, transmission and security of Filtered AI Content (the “AI Security Program”).

2.5.2. <u>Certifications</u>. Sitetracker will establish and maintain an ISO27001
certification for the AI Security Program. In addition, Sitetracker may establish additional
certifications in the future, which may include an ISO 27018 certification.

---

2.5.3. <u>Data Separation & Encryption at Rest</u>. Sitetracker may, but is not obligated
to, apply a logical separation of Filtered AI Content, except that Sitetracker will deploy
standard technologies to encrypt data at rest.

2.5.4. <u>Penetration Testing</u>. Sitetracker will conduct penetration testing in
accordance with Sitetracker’s standard security procedures. However, because Filtered
AI Content will be used within a Sitetracker controlled environment, Customer will not be
permitted to perform penetration testing on the environment and no reporting will be
provided.

2.6. <u>Necessary Rights and Privacy Obligations</u>. Customer agrees that it has all
rights necessary to use the Advanced AI and Data Products, including rights to the data.
Customer submits to any Advanced AI and Data Products. Customer is solely
responsible for providing any legally adequate notices to and obtaining any consents
from individuals and all third parties for Sitetracker to perform its rights and obligations
under these Product-Specific Terms.

2.7. <u>Prohibited Use</u>. Customer will not, and will not allow any third party to, (1)
use Advanced AI and Data Products or data from Advanced AI and Data Products to,
directly or indirectly, develop or improve a similar or competing product, service, or
technology; (2) apply any process or procedure to derive the underlying components
(such as the model parameters or model weights) or reproduce the training data of the
Advanced AI and Data Products; or (3) use Advanced AI and Data Products or data
from Advanced AI and Data Products as otherwise prohibited in the Documentation.

2.8. Third Party AI-Specific Terms. Customer’s use of any third-party machine
learning or artificial intelligence in Advanced AI and Data Products is subject to the
additional terms below:

a) Use of Advanced AI and Data Products are subject to <u>AWS's Acceptable Use</u>
<u>Policy</u> and <u>Responsible AI Policy</u>. Advanced AI and Data Products are powered
by Amazon Bedrock, a managed AI infrastructure service provided by Amazon
Web Services, which in turn draws on foundation models made available by
third-party AI model providers. Customer’s use of Advanced AI and Data
Products may therefore also be subject to the applicable terms of those
third-party AI model providers, as set out at
https://aws.amazon.com/legal/bedrock/third-party-models/. By using Advanced AI
and Data Products, Customer agrees to comply with all such applicable policies
and terms.
